notes: BRC-AM7 is Sony's broadcast box-style PTZ camera. Added to PTP3 in v1.3.0 (Jun 2025). Live view uses LiveViewURL (0xD278) — pan/tilt camera type. isPTZF=true: pan/tilt/zoom/focus control via SDIO_ControlPTZF (0x9244). No built-in ND filter (box camera with detachable lens). No T-Number (uses standard broadcast lens mount). Battery=false: AC-powered. The live view sequence for BRC-AM7 differs from standard cameras — uses RTSP URL. No internal media storage in standard broadcast config — slot1/slot2 set to false as uncertain.
